claims.statement: The release adds fix ttm/cascade, compute frenkel, and a QMMM-XTB package for self-consistent periodic GFN1-xTB and GFN2-xTB QM/MM simulations with PPPM electrostatics.
The release adds many KOKKOS, GPU and OPENMP ports, including eam/he, TIP4P styles, pace optimizations, and rigid/small, plus more built-in testing.

questions: How accurately do GFN1/GFN2-xTB QM/MM runs in LAMMPS reproduce reference results for periodic materials?
Do the new KOKKOS ports of pace and eam/he give results consistent with CPU versions and what speedups?
report.summary: The source is a LAMMPS release-candidate note listing software additions (BPM peridynamics, fix ttm/cascade, compute frenkel, QMMM-XTB, KOKKOS/GPU ports, library updates). It reports no benchmarks or validation of physical accuracy, so scientific usefulness and performance claims remain untested. Principal limitation: release notes only, no measured results.
